name: The Thing You Did Not Mean to Make

pages.text: Reach for something too ambitious too early, and the stone will give you a crude lump with an edge on it instead.$(br2)Keep it. Use it. It is older than almost anything else anyone will ever make.
Hands that have made the crude thing remember where not to strike.$(br2)Hands that skipped it will learn the same lesson more expensively, one good stone at a time.
